notes:
- Textured furniture: desks, tables, cabinets, couches, beds, cars and other props now get pixel
  textures picked from their colour (wood, brushed metal, fabric, painted plastic) instead of flat colour.
- Stairs look like stairs: every step is textured (concrete, wood or metal by map) instead of
  alternating textured and flat blocks.
- Lab floor grating is finer and softer; it no longer reads as a giant black cage.
- Lab blast doors: the hazard stripes are a clean band along the bottom instead of stretched diagonals.
- Perk machines: the perk name is readable on the lit sign (it was hidden inside it) and the price
  sits on its own plate.
- Melee weapon wall-buys: the bat, axe and katana are centred on their boards.
- No more clutter in front of machines: furniture, keycard and intel pedestals no longer end up in
  front of perk machines, the Mystery Box, wall-buys or the upgrade machine.
- Every map gets all 4 perk machines and the Mystery Box (on some prison layouts a perk machine could
  go missing when the room it was meant for was full).
- No wall-buys on see-through chain-link fences any more.
- Raised the OpenGL renderer's light limits so parts of rooms no longer go dark on the fallback renderer.
